protocol.training: weight per-row standardized residual MSE; normalize weights by their training mean
protocol.large_change: balanced absolute actual state change >= original training 90th percentile (default)
protocol.epoch_and_initialization_selection: unchanged: minimize overall validation balanced MAE
protocol.strength_selection: minimize validation large-change MAE subject to ordinary and overall tolerances vs weight 1
protocol.test_point_estimate_gate: large-change MAE improves vs original NN; ordinary and overall within tolerances in every split
limits: Fresh test confirms a hypothesis motivated by earlier test results; earlier tests are not reused.
Large-change membership uses outcomes only for training weights and retrospective evaluation, never inference inputs.
Subgroups overlap. Intervals resample paired episodes; exploratory comparisons are not multiplicity-adjusted.
Test selection is forbidden: nonselected weight results remain diagnostic.
Forecasts are on-policy, standard GridWorld, full horizons only; no decision-benefit claim.
